events.strEvent: Golden State Valkyries vs Atlanta Dream
events.strFilename: WNBA 2026-11-01 Golden State Valkyries vs Atlanta Dream
events.strDescriptionEN: The Golden State Valkyries and Atlanta Dream meet at Chase Center in a winner-take-all Game 7 for the WNBA championship. After splitting the first six games, Golden State return home with a chance to win the first title in franchise history, while Atlanta aim to complete their own championship run on the road. As the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history, the matchup carries immediate historic significance.
